sentences.zh: 推天正冬至：置距所求積年，以歲周乘之，為氣積分；

translations.literal: To calculate the winter solstice of the civil new year: set the accumulated years from the distance sought, multiply by the tropical year cycle to obtain the qi accumulated parts;
translations.idiomatic: To calculate the winter solstice of the civil new year: take the accumulated years from the epoch sought, multiply by the tropical year cycle to obtain the qi accumulated parts;

sentences.zh: 以旬周去之，不盡，總法約之為大餘，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: remove by the ten-day cycle; what is not exhausted, reduce by the general divisor to obtain the major remainder, what does not fill is the minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: divide out the ten-day cycle; the remainder, reduced by the general divisor, yields the major remainder; what is left below that is the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 大餘命甲子，算外，即得所求年天正冬至日辰及餘。

translations.literal: With the major remainder, count from jiazi, outside the count, and one obtains the day, double-hour, and remainder of the winter solstice of the civil new year for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count the major remainder from jiazi, one step outside the count, and one obtains the day, double-hour, and remainder of the winter solstice of the civil new year for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 其小餘總法退除為約分，即百為母。

translations.literal: For its minor remainder, withdraw and divide by the general divisor to obtain reduced fractions, taking one hundred as the denominator.
translations.idiomatic: For the minor remainder, divide back through the general divisor to obtain reduced fractions, with one hundred as the denominator.

sentences.zh: 求次氣：置冬至大、小餘，以氣策及餘秒加之，秒盈秒法從一小余，小余滿總法從一大余，滿紀法去，命甲子，算外，合得次氣日辰及餘秒。

translations.literal: To seek the next qi: set the major and minor remainders of the winter solstice, add the qi interval and its remainder and seconds; when seconds fill the second divisor carry one to the minor remainder, when the minor remainder fills the general divisor carry one to the major remainder, when full remove by the era-cycle divisor, count from jiazi, outside the count, and in combination obtain the day, double-hour, remainder, and seconds of the next qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next qi: set the winter solstice major and minor remainders, add the qi interval together with its remainder and seconds; when seconds fill the second divisor carry one into the minor remainder, when the minor remainder fills the general divisor carry one into the major remainder, when full remove the era-cycle divisor, count from jiazi one step outside the count, and thereby obtain the day, double-hour, remainder, and seconds of the next qi.

sentences.zh: 求天正經朔：置天正冬至氣積分，以朔實去之，不盡為閏餘；

translations.literal: To seek the canonical new moon of the civil new year: set the qi accumulated parts of the winter solstice of the civil new year, remove by the new-moon constant; what is not exhausted is the intercalary remainder;
translations.idiomatic: To find the canonical new moon of the civil new year: set the qi accumulated parts of the civil winter solstice, divide out the new-moon constant; the remainder is the intercalary remainder;

sentences.zh: 以減冬至氣積分，餘為天正十一月經朔加時朔積分；

translations.literal: subtract from the winter solstice qi accumulated parts; the remainder is the accumulated new-moon parts at the hour of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year;
translations.idiomatic: subtract this from the winter solstice qi accumulated parts; the remainder is the accumulated new-moon parts at the hour of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year;

sentences.zh: 以旬周去之，不滿，總法約之為大餘，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: remove by the ten-day cycle; what does not fill, reduce by the general divisor to obtain the major remainder, what does not fill is the minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: divide out the ten-day cycle; what remains, reduced by the general divisor, yields the major remainder; what is left below that is the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 命甲子，算外，即得所求年天正十一月經朔加時朔積分。

translations.literal: Count from jiazi, outside the count, and one obtains the accumulated new-moon parts at the hour of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count from jiazi one step outside the count, and one obtains the accumulated new-moon parts at the hour of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 以旬周去之，不滿，總法約之為大餘，不滿為小餘。

translations.literal: Remove by the ten-day cycle; what does not fill, reduce by the general divisor to obtain the major remainder; what does not fill is the minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 大餘命甲子，算外，即得所求天正十一月經朔日辰及餘。

translations.literal: With the major remainder count from jiazi, outside the count, and one obtains the day, double-hour, and remainder of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count the major remainder from jiazi one step outside the count, and one obtains the day, double-hour, and remainder of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year for the year sought.

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔經日：置天正十一月經朔大、小餘，以弦策加之，為上弦；

translations.literal: To seek the quarter-moon, full-moon, and subsequent canonical new-moon days: set the major and minor remainders of the canonical new moon of the eleventh month of the civil new year, add the quarter-moon interval to obtain the first quarter;
translations.idiomatic: To find the quarter-moon, full-moon, and subsequent canonical new-moon days: set the major and minor remainders of the civil eleventh-month canonical new moon, add the quarter-moon interval to obtain the first quarter;

sentences.zh: 累加之，去命如前，各得弦、望及次月朔經日及餘也。

translations.literal: add cumulatively, remove and count as before, and in each case obtain the canonical days and remainders of the quarter-moon, full moon, and new moon of the following month.
translations.idiomatic: add cumulatively, and by removing and counting as before one obtains in each case the canonical days and remainders for the quarter-moon, full moon, and new moon of the following month.

sentences.zh: 求沒日：置有沒之氣小餘，以一百八十乘之，秒從之，用減一百二十六萬五千五百六十九，余以一萬八千一百六十九除之為日，不滿為餘。

translations.literal: To seek the disappearance day: set the minor remainder of the qi that has a disappearance, multiply it by one hundred eighty with seconds following, use this to subtract from one million two hundred sixty-five thousand five hundred sixty-nine; divide the remainder by eighteen thousand one hundred sixty-nine to obtain days, what does not fill is the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the disappearance day: set the minor remainder of the qi subject to disappearance, multiply it by 180 with seconds carried along, subtract this from 1,265,569; divide the remainder by 18,169 to obtain days, and what is left is the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命其氣初日，算外，即得其氣辰。

translations.literal: Count from the first day of that qi, outside the count, and one obtains its qi double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Count from the first day of that qi one step outside the count, and one obtains its qi double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求滅日：置有滅經朔小餘，三十乘之，滿朔虛分除為日，不滿為餘。

translations.idiomatic: To find the extinction day: set the minor remainder of the canonical new moon subject to extinction, multiply by 30, and when full divide by the new-moon void fraction to obtain days; what is left is the remainder.

sentences.zh: 命經朔初日，算外，即得其月滅日辰。

translations.idiomatic: Count from the first day of the canonical new moon one step outside the count, and one obtains the extinction day and double-hour of that month.

sentences.zh: 經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者，為有滅之朔。

translations.literal: When the minor remainder of the canonical new moon does not fill the new-moon void fraction, it is a new moon that has an extinction.
translations.idiomatic: When the minor remainder of the canonical new moon falls short of the new-moon void fraction, that new moon is subject to extinction.
